% =========================================================================
% TEAM DESIGN CLASS SPECIFICATIONS
% =========================================================================
% This document provides detailed design class diagrams (DCDs) realized in 
% code and architecture across the platform (controllers, services,
% repositories, entities, DTOs, and enumerations).
%
% =========================================================================
% COMPREHENSIVE USE CASE TRACEABILITY MATRIX:
% =========================================================================
% 1. Alejandro (Alex) Garcia Jr:
%    - UC: Search for Artist -- Fan
%      * Controller: ArtistController.searchArtists(...)
%      * Service: ArtistService.searchArtists(...), distanceKm(...)
%      * Repositories: ArtistRepository.searchWithinBounds(...), UserAccountRepository
%      * DTOs / Models: ArtistSearchCriteria, ArtistSearchResult, Artist
%      * Security: AccessControlService.requireRole(..., Role.FAN)
%    - UC: Create Event -- Artist
%      * Controller: EventController.createEvent(...)
%      * Service: EventService.createEvent(...), validateEvent(...)
%      * Repositories: EventRepository.save(...), UserAccountRepository
%      * DTOs / Models: CreateEventRequest, TicketTier, Event, EventStatus
%      * Security: AccessControlService.requireRole(..., Role.ARTIST)
%    - UC: Review Report -- Admin
%      * Controller: ReportController.getPendingReports(...), resolveReport(...)
%      * Service: ReportService.resolveReport(...), applyAction(...), removeContent(...)
%      * Repositories: ReportRepository, PostRepository, UserAccountRepository
%      * Models / Enums: Report, ResolveReportRequest, ReportStatus, ModerationAction, ReportTargetType
%      * Notification: NotificationService.notify(...)
%
% 2. Nicholas Nolen:
%    - UC: Update Event (Step 5 input validation, Step 6 review acknowledgment)
%      * Controller: EventController.updateEvent(...)
%      * Service: EventService.updateEvent(...), validateEventInput(...)
%      * Repositories: EventRepository.findById(...), EventRepository.save(...)
%      * Models: Event (reviewedAcknowledgment, eventType, startsAt, status)
%    - UC: Unban Fan (Conflict of interest guard, AI ToS evaluation, clean fake data)
%      * Controller: ModerationController.getOpenAppeals(...), unbanFan(...), markAppealInvalid(...)
%      * Service: ModerationService.getOpenAppealsForAdmin(...), unbanFan(...), checkConflictOfInterest(...)
%      * Repositories: BanAppealRepository, FanRepository
%      * Models / Enums: BanAppeal, Fan, AppealStatus (OPEN, APPROVED, INVALID)
%    - UC: Receive Recommendation (Weighted interaction affinities, live recommendation ranking)
%      * Controller: RecommendationController.getRecommendations(...), recordInteraction(...)
%      * Service: RecommendationService.getRecommendations(...), calculateAffinityScores(...), buildRankedRecommendations(...)
%      * Repositories: UserInteractionRepository, ArtistRepository
%      * DTOs / Models: RecommendationDTO, ArtistRecommendation, UserInteraction
%
% 3. William Waweru:
%    - UC: Follow Artist -- Fan
%      * Controller: FollowController.followArtist(...), isFollowing(...)
%      * Service: FollowService.followArtist(...), isFollowing(...), createFollow(...)
%      * Repositories: FollowRepository, UserAccountRepository
%      * Models: Fan, Artist, UserInteraction ("FOLLOW" weight 5.0)
%    - UC: Manage Fan Profile -- Fan
%      * Controller: ProfileController.getProfile(...), updateProfile(...)
%      * Service: ProfileService.getProfile(...), updateProfile(...), validateProfile(...)
%      * Repositories: ProfileRepository, UserAccountRepository
%      * Models: Profile (avatarURL, displayTheme, privacySetting), Fan
%    - UC: Report Inappropriate Content -- Fan (Client-side submission)
%      * Controller: ReportController.submitReport(...)
%      * Service: ReportService.submitReport(...), validateReport(...), findPendingReport(...)
%      * Repositories: ReportRepository, PostRepository (ContentRepository)
%      * Models / Enums: Report (PENDING status), ReportTargetType
%
% 4. Garrett DeYong:
%    - UC: Make a Post -- Artist
%      * Controller: PostController.savePost(...)
%      * Service: PostService.savePost(...)
%      * Repositories: PostRepository, FileRepository
%      * Models / Wrappers: Post, PostFile, PostWrapper
%    - UC: Message Another User (Beginning a New Conversation)
%      * Controller: ConversationController.saveConversation(...), saveMessage(...)
%      * Service: ConversationService.saveConversation(...), saveMessage(...)
%      * Repositories: ConversationRepository
%      * Models / Wrappers: Conversation, Message, MessageWrapper, UserWrapper
%    - UC: Monitor Comments -- Artist
%      * Controller: PostController.getAllPostsByUser(...), getPostById(...)
%      * Service: PostService.getAllPostsByUser(...), getPostById(...)
%      * Repositories: PostRepository, FileRepository
%
% 5. Gan-Orgil Gantumur:
%    - UC: Suspending Artist Account -- Admin
%      * Controller: ModerationController.suspendArtist(...)
%      * Service: ModerationService.suspendArtist(...)
%      * Repositories: ArtistRepository
%      * Models: Artist.isSuspended
%    - UC: Approve Artist Verification Application -- Admin
%      * Controller: ModerationController.getPendingApplications(...), approveApplication(...), rejectApplication(...)
%      * Service: ModerationService.getPendingApplications(...), approveApplication(...), rejectApplication(...)
%      * Repositories: ArtistApplicationRepository
%      * Models: ArtistApplication
%    - UC: Comment on Artwork -- Fan
%      * Controller: PostController.commentOnArtwork(...)
%      * Service: PostService.addComment(...)
%      * Repositories: UserInteractionRepository
%      * Models: UserInteraction (postId, fanId, artistId, genre, content)
% =========================================================================

\subsection{Discovery, Following, Events, and Personalized Recommendations}

% -------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Subsystem 1 Controllers, Services, and Repositories
% Realizes:
%   - Alex Garcia: UC Search for Artist, UC Create Event
%   - Nicholas Nolen: UC Update Event, UC Receive Recommendation
%   - William Waweru: UC Follow Artist -- Fan
% -------------------------------------------------------------------------
\subsubsection*{Controllers, Services, and Repositories}
\begin{center}\rotatebox{90}{\resizebox{0.92\textheight}{!}{%
\begin{tikzpicture}
  % ---------- Controllers ----------
  \begin{class}[text width=9cm]{ArtistController}{0,0}
    \operation{+ searchArtists(fanId : Long, name : String, genre : String,}
    \operation{\quad location : String, lat : Double, lng : Double,}
    \operation{\quad radiusKm : Double) : List\textless ArtistSearchResult\textgreater}
    \operation{+ getAllArtists() : List\textless Artist\textgreater}
    \operation{+ getArtistById(id : Long) : Artist}
  \end{class}

  \begin{class}[text width=8.5cm]{FollowController}{9.5,0}
    \operation{+ followArtist(fanId : Long, artistId : Long) : boolean}
    \operation{+ isFollowing(fanId : Long, artistId : Long) : boolean}
  \end{class}

  \begin{class}[text width=10.5cm]{EventController}{18.5,0}
    \operation{+ createEvent(userId : Long, request : CreateEventRequest) : Event}
    \operation{+ getMyEvents(userId : Long) : List\textless Event\textgreater}
    \operation{+ getAllEvents() : List\textless Event\textgreater}
    \operation{+ getEventById(id : Long) : Event}
    \operation{+ getEventsByArtist(artistId : Long) : List\textless Event\textgreater}
    \operation{+ updateEvent(id : Long, updatedEvent : Event) : Event}
    \operation{+ deleteEvent(id : Long) : void}
  \end{class}

  \begin{class}[text width=9.5cm]{RecommendationController}{29.5,0}
    \operation{+ getRecommendations(fanId : Long) : RecommendationDTO}
    \operation{+ recordInteraction(fanId : Long, artistId : Long,}
    \operation{\quad interactionType : String) : UserInteraction}
  \end{class}

  % ---------- Services ----------
  \begin{class}[text width=9cm]{ArtistService}{0,-6}
    \attribute{- MAX\_RADIUS\_KM : double = 500}
    \operation{+ searchArtists(fanId : Long, criteria : ArtistSearchCriteria)}
    \operation{\quad : List\textless ArtistSearchResult\textgreater}
    \operation{+ getAllArtists(includeSuspended : boolean) : List\textless Artist\textgreater}
    \operation{+ getArtistById(artistId : Long) : Artist}
    \operation{- resolveOrigin(fan : UserAccount, criteria : ArtistSearchCriteria) : double[2]}
    \operation{- searchNearby(name, genre, location : String, lat, lng, radiusKm : double)}
    \operation{\quad : List\textless ArtistSearchResult\textgreater}
    \operation{\underline{distanceKm(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2 : double) : double}}
  \end{class}

  \begin{class}[text width=8.5cm]{FollowService}{9.5,-6}
    \operation{+ followArtist(fanId : Long, artistId : Long) : boolean}
    \operation{+ isFollowing(fanId : Long, artistId : Long) : boolean}
    \operation{+ findArtist(artistId : Long) : Artist}
    \operation{+ createFollow(fanId : Long, artistId : Long) : void}
    \operation{+ updateFollowerInfo(artistId : Long) : void}
  \end{class}

  \begin{class}[text width=10.5cm]{EventService}{18.5,-6}
    \operation{+ createEvent(userId : Long, request : CreateEventRequest) : Event}
    \operation{+ getEventsForArtist(userId : Long) : List\textless Event\textgreater}
    \operation{+ getAllEvents() : List\textless Event\textgreater}
    \operation{+ getEventById(eventId : Long) : Event}
    \operation{+ getEventsByArtist(artistId : Long) : List\textless Event\textgreater}
    \operation{+ updateEvent(eventId : Long, updatedInfo : Event) : Event}
    \operation{+ deleteEvent(eventId : Long) : void}
    \operation{\textasciitilde\ validateEvent(request : CreateEventRequest) : void}
    \operation{- validateEventInput(event : Event) : void}
  \end{class}

  \begin{class}[text width=9.5cm]{RecommendationService}{29.5,-6}
    \operation{+ getRecommendations(fanId : Long) : RecommendationDTO}
    \operation{+ recordInteraction(fanId : Long, artistId : Long,}
    \operation{\quad type : String) : UserInteraction}
    \operation{- calculateAffinityScores(interactions : List\textless UserInteraction\textgreater)}
    \operation{\quad : Map\textless String, Double\textgreater}
    \operation{- buildRankedRecommendations(scores : Map\textless String, Double\textgreater)}
    \operation{\quad : List\textless ArtistRecommendation\textgreater}
  \end{class}

  \begin{class}[text width=8cm]{AccessControlService}{7,-12.5}
    \operation{+ requireRole(userId : Long, role : Role) : UserAccount}
  \end{class}

  % ---------- Repositories ----------
  \begin{interface}[text width=7.5cm]{ArtistRepository}{0,-17.5}
    \operation{+ search(name, genre, location : String) : List\textless Artist\textgreater}
    \operation{+ searchWithinBounds(name, genre, location : String,}
    \operation{\quad minLat, maxLat, minLng, maxLng : double) : List\textless Artist\textgreater}
    \operation{+ findArtistById(id : Long) : Artist}
  \end{interface}

  \begin{interface}[text width=7.5cm]{FollowRepository}{8,-17.5}
    \operation{+ isFollowing(fanId : Long, artistId : Long) : boolean}
    \operation{+ createFollow(fanId : Long, artistId : Long) : void}
    \operation{+ findByFanId(fanId : Long) : List\textless Long\textgreater}
  \end{interface}

  \begin{interface}[text width=6cm]{UserAccountRepository}{16,-17.5}
    \operation{+ findById(id : Long) : UserAccount}
    \operation{+ save(account : UserAccount) : UserAccount}
  \end{interface}

  \begin{interface}[text width=7.5cm]{EventRepository}{22.5,-17.5}
    \operation{+ save(event : Event) : Event}
    \operation{+ findById(id : Long) : Event}
    \operation{+ findEventById(id : Long) : Event}
    \operation{+ findByArtistId(artistId : Long) : List\textless Event\textgreater}
    \operation{+ findByArtistIdOrderByStartsAtAsc(}
    \operation{\quad artistId : Long) : List\textless Event\textgreater}
  \end{interface}

  \begin{interface}[text width=7.5cm]{UserInteractionRepository}{30.5,-17.5}
    \operation{+ findByFanIdOrderByTimestampDesc(}
    \operation{\quad fanId : Long) : List\textless UserInteraction\textgreater}
    \operation{+ save(ui : UserInteraction) : UserInteraction}
  \end{interface}

  % ---------- Relationships ----------
  \unidirectionalAssociation{ArtistController}{}{1}{ArtistService}
  \unidirectionalAssociation{FollowController}{}{1}{FollowService}
  \unidirectionalAssociation{EventController}{}{1}{EventService}
  \unidirectionalAssociation{RecommendationController}{}{1}{RecommendationService}

  \draw[umlcd style, ->] (ArtistService.south) -- (AccessControlService.north west);
  \draw[umlcd style, ->] (EventService.south) -- (AccessControlService.north east);
  \draw[umlcd style, ->] (RecommendationService.south west) -- (AccessControlService.east);

  \draw[umlcd style, ->] (ArtistService.south) -- (ArtistRepository.north);
  \draw[umlcd style, ->] (FollowService.south) -- (FollowRepository.north);
  \draw[umlcd style, ->] (AccessControlService.south) -- (UserAccountRepository.north);
  \draw[umlcd style, ->] (EventService.south) -- (EventRepository.north);
  \draw[umlcd style, ->] (RecommendationService.south) -- (UserInteractionRepository.north);
\end{tikzpicture}}}\end{center}

% -------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Subsystem 1 Entities, Request/Response Objects, and Enumerations
% Realizes:
%   - Artist (with suspension state and geolocation)
%   - Event (with ticket tier composition, lifecycle status, draft & review acknowledgment)
%   - UserInteraction (covers FOLLOW, LIKE, VIEW, COMMENT) & RecommendationDTO / ArtistRecommendation
%   - ArtistSearchCriteria, ArtistSearchResult, CreateEventRequest
% -------------------------------------------------------------------------
\subsubsection*{Entities, Request/Response Objects, and Enumerations}
\begin{center}\rotatebox{90}{\resizebox{0.92\textheight}{!}{%
\begin{tikzpicture}
  % ---------- Column 1: Artist & EventStatus ----------
  \begin{class}[text width=6.5cm]{Artist}{0,0}
    \attribute{- id : Long}
    \attribute{- name : String}
    \attribute{- genre : String}
    \attribute{- location : String}
    \attribute{- profileThumbnail : String}
    \attribute{- bio : String}
    \attribute{- tags : String}
    \attribute{- isSuspended : boolean}
    \attribute{- latitude : Double}
    \attribute{- longitude : Double}
    \operation{+ isSuspended() : boolean}
  \end{class}

  \begin{class}[text width=5cm]{EventStatus}{0,-9.5}
    \attribute{\emph{$\ll$enumeration$\gg$}}
    \attribute{DRAFT}
    \attribute{PENDING\_APPROVAL}
    \attribute{PUBLISHED}
    \attribute{REMOVED}
  \end{class}

  % ---------- Column 2: Event & TicketTier ----------
  \begin{class}[text width=7cm]{Event}{8.5,0}
    \attribute{- id : Long}
    \attribute{- artistId : Long}
    \attribute{- eventType : String}
    \attribute{- title : String}
    \attribute{- description : String}
    \attribute{- startsAt : LocalDateTime}
    \attribute{- location : String}
    \attribute{- virtual : boolean}
    \attribute{- capacity : Integer}
    \attribute{- imageUrl : String}
    \attribute{- ticketTiers : List\textless TicketTier\textgreater}
    \attribute{- status : EventStatus}
    \attribute{- reviewedAcknowledgment : boolean}
    \attribute{- createdAt : LocalDateTime}
    \attribute{- updatedAt : LocalDateTime}
    \operation{+ getEventDate() : LocalDateTime}
    \operation{+ isReviewedAcknowledgment() : boolean}
  \end{class}

  \begin{class}[text width=6cm]{TicketTier}{8.5,-12}
    \attribute{- name : String}
    \attribute{- price : BigDecimal}
    \operation{+ getName() : String}
    \operation{+ getPrice() : BigDecimal}
  \end{class}

  % ---------- Column 3: Interaction & Recommendations ----------
  \begin{class}[text width=7.5cm]{UserInteraction}{18,0}
    \attribute{- id : Long}
    \attribute{- fanId : Long}
    \attribute{- artistId : Long}
    \attribute{- interactionType : String}
    \attribute{- genre : String}
    \attribute{- weight : double}
    \attribute{- timestamp : LocalDateTime}
    \attribute{- postId : Long}
    \attribute{- content : String}
    \operation{+ getWeight() : double}
  \end{class}

  \begin{class}[text width=7.5cm]{RecommendationDTO}{18,-7.5}
    \attribute{+ hasInteractions : boolean}
    \attribute{+ message : String}
    \attribute{+ genreAffinityScores : Map\textless String, Double\textgreater}
    \attribute{+ recommendations : List\textless ArtistRecommendation\textgreater}
  \end{class}

  \begin{class}[text width=7.5cm]{ArtistRecommendation}{18,-12.5}
    \attribute{+ artist : Artist}
    \attribute{+ matchPercentage : double}
    \attribute{+ matchingGenres : List\textless String\textgreater}
    \attribute{+ reason : String}
    \attribute{+ latentFeatureSummary : String}
  \end{class}

  % ---------- Column 4: DTOs ----------
  \begin{class}[text width=7.5cm]{ArtistSearchCriteria}{27.5,0}
    \attribute{+ name, genre, location : String}
    \attribute{+ latitude, longitude : Double [0..1]}
    \attribute{+ radiusKm : Double [0..1]}
  \end{class}

  \begin{class}[text width=7.5cm]{ArtistSearchResult}{27.5,-4.5}
    \attribute{+ id : Long}
    \attribute{+ name, genre, location : String}
    \attribute{+ profileThumbnail : String}
    \attribute{+ distanceKm : Double [0..1]}
  \end{class}

  \begin{class}[text width=7.5cm]{CreateEventRequest}{27.5,-9.5}
    \attribute{+ title, description, location : String}
    \attribute{+ startsAt : LocalDateTime}
    \attribute{+ virtual : boolean}
    \attribute{+ capacity : Integer}
    \attribute{+ ticketTiers : List\textless TicketTierRequest\textgreater}
    \attribute{+ saveAsDraft : boolean}
  \end{class}

  % ---------- Relationships ----------
  \composition{Event}{ticketTiers}{1..*}{TicketTier}
  \unidirectionalAssociation{Event}{status}{1}{EventStatus}
  \composition{RecommendationDTO}{recommendations}{0..*}{ArtistRecommendation}
  \draw[umlcd style, ->] (RecommendationDTO.north) -- node[right, font=\small]{computed from} (UserInteraction.south);
  \draw[umlcd style, ->] (Event.west) -- node[above, font=\small]{hosted by} (Artist.east);
\end{tikzpicture}}}\end{center}

  \begin{class}[text width=10.5cm]{ReportService}{9.2,-6.5}

  \begin{class}[text width=11.5cm]{ModerationService}{20.5,-6.5}

  \end{interface}

  \unidirectionalAssociation{ProfileController}{}{1}{ProfileService}

% -------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Subsystem 2 Entities, Request/Response Objects, and Enumerations
% Realizes:
%   - UserAccount, Fan, Admin identity hierarchy
%   - Profile (avatar, theme, privacy)
%   - Report & BanAppeal moderation entities
%   - ArtistApplication verification entity
%   - Role, AccountStatus, AppealStatus, ModerationAction, ReportTargetType enums
% -------------------------------------------------------------------------
\subsubsection*{Entities, Request/Response Objects, and Enumerations}
\begin{center}\rotatebox{90}{\resizebox{0.92\textheight}{!}{%
\begin{tikzpicture}
% ---------- Column 0: User Enumerations ----------
  \begin{class}[text width=3.8cm]{Role}{-4.5,0}
    \attribute{\emph{$\ll$enumeration$\gg$}}
    \attribute{FAN}
    \attribute{ARTIST}
    \attribute{ADMIN}
  \end{class}

  \begin{class}[text width=3.8cm]{AccountStatus}{-4.5,-4.0}
    \attribute{\emph{$\ll$enumeration$\gg$}}
    \attribute{ACTIVE}
    \attribute{SUSPENDED}
    \attribute{BANNED}
  \end{class}

  % ---------- Column 1: Identity (UserAccount & Fan) ----------
  \begin{class}[text width=6.2cm]{UserAccount}{1.2,0}
    \attribute{- id : Long}
    \attribute{- username : String}
    \attribute{- displayName : String}
    \attribute{- role : Role}
    \attribute{- status : AccountStatus}
    \attribute{- artistId : Long [0..1]}
    \attribute{- latitude : Double [0..1]}
    \attribute{- longitude : Double [0..1]}
    \attribute{- searchRadiusKm : Double [0..1]}
    \operation{+ isActive() : boolean}
  \end{class}

  \begin{class}[text width=6.2cm]{Fan}{1.2,-9.5}
    \attribute{- id : Long}
    \attribute{- username : String}
    \attribute{- email : String}
    \attribute{- banned : boolean}
    \attribute{- canLogin : boolean}
    \attribute{- canAppeal : boolean}
    \operation{+ isEligibleForAppeal() : boolean}
  \end{class}

  % ---------- Column 2: Profile & Verification Application ----------
  \begin{class}[text width=5.8cm]{Profile}{8.8,0}
    \attribute{- profileID : Long}
    \attribute{- avatarURL : String}
    \attribute{- displayTheme : String}
    \attribute{- privacySetting : String}
    \operation{+ updateTheme(theme : String) : void}
  \end{class}

  \begin{class}[text width=6.2cm]{ArtistApplication}{8.8,-9.5}
    \attribute{- id : Long}
    \attribute{- fanId : Long}
    \attribute{- applicantName : String}
    \attribute{- proposedGenre : String}
    \attribute{- portfolioLinks : String}
    \attribute{- status : String}
    \attribute{- submittedAt : LocalDateTime}
  \end{class}

  % ---------- Column 3: Moderation (Report, Requests, Enums, Notification) ----------
  \begin{class}[text width=7.2cm]{Report}{17.5,0}
    \attribute{- id : Long}
    \attribute{- reporterId : Long}
    \attribute{- targetType : ReportTargetType}
    \attribute{- targetId : Long}
    \attribute{- reportedUserId : Long}
    \attribute{- reason : String}
    \attribute{- status : ReportStatus}
    \attribute{- createdAt : LocalDateTime}
    \attribute{- action : ModerationAction [0..1]}
    \attribute{- resolvedBy : Long [0..1]}
    \attribute{- resolvedAt : LocalDateTime [0..1]}
    \attribute{- resolutionNotes : String [0..1]}
  \end{class}

  \begin{class}[text width=5.0cm]{ResolveReportRequest}{14.8,-10.5}
    \attribute{+ action : ModerationAction}
    \attribute{+ notes : String}
  \end{class}

  \begin{class}[text width=5.0cm]{Notification}{14.8,-14.2}
    \attribute{- id : Long}
    \attribute{- recipientId : Long}
    \attribute{- message : String}
    \attribute{- createdAt : LocalDateTime}
  \end{class}

  \begin{class}[text width=4.4cm]{ModerationAction}{20.4,-10.5}
    \attribute{\emph{$\ll$enumeration$\gg$}}
    \attribute{DISMISS}
    \attribute{WARN\_USER}
    \attribute{REMOVE\_CONTENT}
    \attribute{SUSPEND\_USER}
    \attribute{BAN\_USER}
  \end{class}

  \begin{class}[text width=4.4cm]{ReportTargetType}{20.4,-15.0}
    \attribute{\emph{$\ll$enumeration$\gg$}}
    \attribute{POST}
    \attribute{EVENT}
    \attribute{USER}
  \end{class}

  % ---------- Column 4: Fan Appeals & Status ----------
  \begin{class}[text width=7.5cm]{BanAppeal}{27.5,0}
    \attribute{- id : Long}
    \attribute{- fanId : Long}
    \attribute{- fanUsername : String}
    \attribute{- banningAdminId : Long}
    \attribute{- banningAdminName : String}
    \attribute{- reviewingAdminId : Long [0..1]}
    \attribute{- reason : String}
    \attribute{- offendingContent : String}
    \attribute{- reportMaterial : String}
    \attribute{- aiRecommendation : String}
    \attribute{- status : AppealStatus}
    \attribute{- reviewNotes : String [0..1]}
    \attribute{- createdAt : LocalDateTime}
    \attribute{- reviewedAt : LocalDateTime [0..1]}
    \operation{+ canReview(adminId : Long) : boolean}
  \end{class}

  \begin{class}[text width=4.2cm]{AppealStatus}{27.5,-12.5}
    \attribute{\emph{$\ll$enumeration$\gg$}}
    \attribute{OPEN}
    \attribute{APPROVED}
    \attribute{INVALID}
  \end{class}

  % ---------- Relationships ----------
  \draw[->, >=angle 90, color=red!70!black] (UserAccount.west) -- node[above, font=\footnotesize]{role} (Role.east);
  \draw[->, >=angle 90, color=red!70!black] (UserAccount.west) -- node[below, font=\footnotesize]{status} (AccountStatus.east);
  \draw[->, >=angle 90, color=red!70!black] (UserAccount.east) -- node[above, font=\footnotesize]{profile} (Profile.west);

  \draw[->, >=angle 90, color=red!70!black] (Fan.north) -- node[right, font=\footnotesize]{extends} (UserAccount.south);
  \draw[->, >=angle 90, color=red!70!black] (ArtistApplication.west) -- node[above=1pt, font=\scriptsize]{submitted by} (Fan.east);

  \draw[->, >=angle 90, color=red!70!black] (Report.south) -- (ResolveReportRequest.north);
  \draw[->, >=angle 90, color=red!70!black] (Report.south) -- node[above, font=\footnotesize]{action [0..1]} (ModerationAction.north);
  \draw[->, >=angle 90, color=red!70!black] (Report.east) -- ++(0.8, 0) |- node[pos=0.75, right, font=\footnotesize]{targetType} (ReportTargetType.east);
  \draw[->, >=angle 90, color=red!70!black] (ResolveReportRequest.south) -- node[right, font=\footnotesize]{notifies [0..2]} (Notification.north);
  \draw[->, >=angle 90, color=red!70!black] (ResolveReportRequest.east) -- (ModerationAction.west);

  \draw[->, >=angle 90, color=red!70!black] (BanAppeal.south) -- node[right, font=\footnotesize]{status} (AppealStatus.north);

  % Clean overhead route for Report targeting UserAccount (NO fill)
  \draw[->, >=angle 90, color=red!70!black] (Report.north) -- ++(0, 1.2) -| node[pos=0.25, above, font=\footnotesize]{targets} (UserAccount.north);

  % Clean underflow route for BanAppeal appealing ban for Fan (NO fill)
  \draw[->, >=angle 90, color=red!70!black] (BanAppeal.south) -- (27.5, -18.5) -- node[pos=0.5, below, font=\footnotesize]{appeals ban for} (1.2, -18.5) -- (Fan.south);
\end{tikzpicture}}}\end{center}

\clearpage
\subsection{Community Posts, Media Attachments, and Direct Messaging}

% -------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Subsystem 3 Controllers, Services, and Repositories
% Realizes:
%   - Garrett DeYong: UC Make a Post -- Artist, UC Message Another User, UC Monitor Comments
%   - Gan-Orgil Gantumur: UC Comment on Artwork -- Fan
% -------------------------------------------------------------------------
\subsubsection*{Controllers, Services, and Repositories}
\begin{center}\rotatebox{90}{\resizebox{0.92\textheight}{!}{%
\begin{tikzpicture}
  % ---------- Controllers ----------
  \begin{class}[text width=11cm]{PostController}{0,0}
    \operation{+ savePost(postWrapper : PostWrapper) : PostWrapper}
    \operation{+ getAllPosts() : List\textless Post\textgreater}
    \operation{+ getAllPostsByUser(posterId : Long) : List\textless Post\textgreater}
    \operation{+ getPostById(postId : Long) : Post}
    \operation{+ getAllFiles() : List\textless PostFile\textgreater}
    \operation{+ getFilesByPostId(postId : Long) : List\textless PostFile\textgreater}
    \operation{+ getFileById(fileId : Long) : PostFile}
    \operation{+ commentOnArtwork(postId : Long, fanId : Long, artistId : Long,}
    \operation{\quad genre : String, content : String) : UserInteraction}
  \end{class}

  \begin{class}[text width=11cm]{ConversationController}{13.5,0}
    \operation{+ saveConversation(userWrapper : UserWrapper) : Conversation}
    \operation{+ saveMessage(messageWrapper : MessageWrapper) : Message}
    \operation{+ getAllConversations() : List\textless Conversation\textgreater}
    \operation{+ getConversation(conversationId : Long) : Conversation}
  \end{class}

  % ---------- Services ----------
  \begin{class}[text width=11cm]{PostService}{0,-6.5}
    \operation{+ savePost(postWrapper : PostWrapper) : PostWrapper}
    \operation{+ getAllPosts() : List\textless Post\textgreater}
    \operation{+ getAllPostsByUser(posterId : Long) : List\textless Post\textgreater}
    \operation{+ getPostById(postId : Long) : Post}
    \operation{+ getAllFiles() : List\textless PostFile\textgreater}
    \operation{+ getFilesByPostId(postId : Long) : List\textless PostFile\textgreater}
    \operation{+ getFileById(fileId : Long) : PostFile}
    \operation{+ addComment(postId : Long, fanId : Long, artistId : Long,}
    \operation{\quad genre : String, content : String) : UserInteraction}
  \end{class}

  \begin{class}[text width=11cm]{ConversationService}{13.5,-6.5}
    \operation{+ saveConversation(userWrapper : UserWrapper) : Conversation}
    \operation{+ saveMessage(messageWrapper : MessageWrapper) : Message}
    \operation{+ getAllConversations() : List\textless Conversation\textgreater}
    \operation{+ getConversationById(conversationId : Long) : Conversation}
    \operation{+ getConversationByUsers(userWrapper : UserWrapper) : Conversation}
  \end{class}

  % ---------- Repositories ----------
  \begin{interface}[text width=6.5cm]{PostRepository}{0,-14}
    \operation{+ save(post : Post) : Post}
    \operation{+ findAll() : List\textless Post\textgreater}
    \operation{+ findByPosterId(posterId : Long)}
    \operation{\quad : List\textless Post\textgreater}
    \operation{+ findPostById(id : Long) : Post}
  \end{interface}

  \begin{interface}[text width=6.5cm]{FileRepository}{7.5,-14}
    \operation{+ save(file : PostFile) : PostFile}
    \operation{+ findAll() : List\textless PostFile\textgreater}
    \operation{+ findByPostId(postId : Long)}
    \operation{\quad : List\textless PostFile\textgreater}
    \operation{+ findFileById(id : Long) : PostFile}
  \end{interface}

  \begin{interface}[text width=8.5cm]{ConversationRepository}{15,-14}
    \operation{+ save(conversation : Conversation) : Conversation}
    \operation{+ findAll() : List\textless Conversation\textgreater}
    \operation{+ findByConversationId(id : Long) : Conversation}
    \operation{+ findByUserIds(u1 : Long, u2 : Long) : Conversation}
  \end{interface}

  % ---------- Relationships ----------
  \unidirectionalAssociation{PostController}{}{1}{PostService}
  \unidirectionalAssociation{ConversationController}{}{1}{ConversationService}

  \draw[umlcd style, ->] (PostService.south) -- (PostRepository.north);
  \draw[umlcd style, ->] (PostService.south) -- (FileRepository.north);
  \draw[umlcd style, ->] (ConversationService.south) -- (ConversationRepository.north);
\end{tikzpicture}}}\end{center}

\clearpage
% -------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Subsystem 3 Entities, Wrappers, and Attachments
% Realizes:
%   - Post & PostFile (media attachments, public/private visibility)
%   - Conversation & Message (direct chat between two users)
%   - PostWrapper, MessageWrapper, UserWrapper (transport containers)
% -------------------------------------------------------------------------
\subsubsection*{Entities, Wrappers, and Attachments}
\begin{center}\rotatebox{90}{\resizebox{0.92\textheight}{!}{%
\begin{tikzpicture}
  % ---------- Column 1: Post & PostFile ----------
  \begin{class}[text width=6.5cm]{Post}{0,0}
    \attribute{- id : Long}
    \attribute{- posterId : Long}
    \attribute{- postDate : LocalDateTime}
    \attribute{- isPublic : boolean}
    \attribute{- commentsAllowed : boolean}
    \attribute{- postText : String}
    \attribute{- hidden : boolean}
  \end{class}

  \begin{class}[text width=6.5cm]{PostFile}{0,-7.5}
    \attribute{- id : Long}
    \attribute{- postId : Long}
    \attribute{- fileName : String}
    \attribute{- fileType : String}
    \attribute{- fileData : String}
  \end{class}

  % ---------- Column 2: PostWrapper ----------
  \begin{class}[text width=6cm]{PostWrapper}{8,-3.5}
    \attribute{+ post : Post}
    \attribute{+ files : List\textless PostFile\textgreater}
  \end{class}

  % ---------- Column 3: Conversation & Message ----------
  \begin{class}[text width=6.8cm]{Conversation}{16.5,0}
    \attribute{- id : Long}
    \attribute{- conversationId : Long}
    \attribute{- user1Id : Long}
    \attribute{- user2Id : Long}
    \attribute{- createdAt : LocalDateTime}
    \attribute{- messages : List\textless Message\textgreater}
  \end{class}

  \begin{class}[text width=6.8cm]{Message}{16.5,-7.5}
    \attribute{- id : Long}
    \attribute{- conversationId : Long}
    \attribute{- senderId : Long}
    \attribute{- recipientId : Long}
    \attribute{- content : String}
    \attribute{- timestamp : LocalDateTime}
    \attribute{- read : boolean}
  \end{class}

  % ---------- Column 4: MessageWrapper & UserWrapper ----------
  \begin{class}[text width=6.2cm]{MessageWrapper}{25,-2}
    \attribute{+ userWrapper : UserWrapper}
    \attribute{+ message : Message}
  \end{class}

  \begin{class}[text width=6.2cm]{UserWrapper}{25,-7.5}
    \attribute{+ users : List\textless UserAccount\textgreater}
    \operation{+ getUser(index : int) : UserAccount}
  \end{class}

  % ---------- Relationships ----------
  \composition{Post}{files}{0..*}{PostFile}
  \composition{Conversation}{messages}{0..*}{Message}
  \draw[umlcd style, ->] (PostWrapper.west) -- (Post.east);
  \draw[umlcd style, ->] (PostWrapper.west) -- (PostFile.east);
  \draw[umlcd style, ->] (MessageWrapper.west) -- (Message.east);
  \draw[umlcd style, ->] (MessageWrapper.south) -- (UserWrapper.north);
\end{tikzpicture}}}\end{center}
